# antd SDK — Complete API Reference

> JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C#, Kotlin, Swift, Go, Java, Rust, C++, Ruby, PHP, Dart, Lua, Elixir, and Zig SDKs for the Autonomi network via the antd daemon. The daemon manages wallet, payments, and network connectivity. Clients connect over REST (default port 8082) or gRPC (default port 50051). All SDKs support automatic port discovery.

## Port Discovery

All SDKs can automatically discover a running antd daemon. On startup, antd writes a `daemon.port` file containing the REST port (line 1) and gRPC port (line 2) to a platform-specific location:

- **Windows:** `%APPDATA%\ant\daemon.port`
- **Linux:** `$XDG_DATA_HOME/ant/daemon.port` (or `~/.local/share/ant/daemon.port`)
- **macOS:** `~/Library/Application Support/ant/daemon.port`

Every SDK provides auto-discover constructors that read this file and connect automatically, falling back to the default ports if no file is found:

| Language | REST Auto-Discover | gRPC Auto-Discover |
|----------|-------------------|-------------------|
| Python | `RestClient.auto_discover()` | `GrpcClient.auto_discover()` |
| Go | `antd.NewClientAutoDiscover()` | `antd.NewGrpcClientAutoDiscover()` |
| TypeScript | `RestClient.autoDiscover()` | N/A |
| C# | `AntdRestClient.AutoDiscover()` | `AntdGrpcClient.AutoDiscover()` |
| Java | `AntdClient.autoDiscover()` | `GrpcAntdClient.autoDiscover()` |
| Rust | `Client::auto_discover()` | `GrpcClient::auto_discover()` |
| Kotlin | `AntdRestClient.autoDiscover()` | `AntdGrpcClient.autoDiscover()` |
| C++ | `Client::auto_discover()` | `GrpcClient::auto_discover()` |
| Dart | `AntdClient.autoDiscover()` | `GrpcAntdClient.autoDiscover()` |
| Elixir | `Antd.Client.auto_discover()` | `Antd.GrpcClient.auto_discover()` |
| Ruby | `Antd::Client.auto_discover` | `Antd::GrpcClient.auto_discover` |
| Swift | `DaemonDiscovery.autoDiscover()` | `DaemonDiscovery.autoDiscoverGrpc()` |
| PHP | `AntdClient::autoDiscover()` | N/A |
| Lua | `Client.auto_discover()` | N/A |
| Zig | `Client.autoDiscover(allocator)` | N/A |

This is especially useful when antd is spawned with `--rest-port 0` (OS assigns a free port), as in managed mode.

## Quick Start

```python
from antd import AntdClient

client = AntdClient()                          # REST, localhost:8082
client = AntdClient(transport="grpc")          # gRPC, localhost:50051
client = AntdClient(base_url="http://remote:8082")

# Store and retrieve data (payment_mode defaults to "auto")
result = client.data_put_public(b"hello world")
print(result.address, result.cost)
data = client.data_get_public(result.address)  # b"hello world"

# Explicit payment mode for large uploads
result = client.data_put_public(large_data, payment_mode="merkle")
```

```typescript
import { createClient } from "@withautonomi/antd";

const client = createClient();                             // REST, localhost:8082
const client = createClient({ baseUrl: "http://remote:8082" });

const result = await client.dataPutPublic(Buffer.from("hello"));
const data = await client.dataGetPublic(result.address);
```

```csharp
using Antd.Sdk;

var client = AntdClientFactory.CreateRest();    // REST, localhost:8082
var client = AntdClientFactory.CreateGrpc();    // gRPC, localhost:50051

var result = await client.DataPutPublicAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("hello"));
var data = await client.DataGetPublicAsync(result.Address);
```

```kotlin
import com.autonomi.sdk.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking

fun main() = runBlocking {
    val client = AntdClient.createRest()         // REST, localhost:8082
    val client = AntdClient.createGrpc()         // gRPC, localhost:50051

    val result = client.dataPutPublic("hello".toByteArray())
    val data = client.dataGetPublic(result.address)
}
```

```swift
// Swift (macOS only — iOS apps should use the FFI bindings)
import AntdSdk

let client = try AntdClient.createRest()          // REST, localhost:8082
let client = try AntdClient.createGrpc()          // gRPC, localhost:50051

let result = try await client.dataPutPublic("hello".data(using: .utf8)!)
let data = try await client.dataGetPublic(address: result.address)
```

```go
// Go
import antd "github.com/WithAutonomi/ant-sdk/antd-go"

client := antd.NewClient(antd.DefaultBaseURL)       // REST, localhost:8082
ctx := context.Background()

result, _ := client.DataPutPublic(ctx, []byte("hello"))
data, _ := client.DataGetPublic(ctx, result.Address)
```

```java
// Java — Gradle: implementation("com.autonomi:antd-java:0.1.0")
//        Maven: <dependency><groupId>com.autonomi</groupId><artifactId>antd-java</artifactId><version>0.1.0</version></dependency>
import com.autonomi.antd.AntdClient;

try (AntdClient client = AntdClient.create()) {           // REST, localhost:8082
    PutResult result = client.dataPutPublic("hello".getBytes());
    byte[] data = client.dataGetPublic(result.address());
}
```

```rust
// Rust — cargo add antd-client
use antd_client::Client;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), antd_client::AntdError> {
    let client = Client::new("http://localhost:8082");     // REST, localhost:8082

    let result = client.data_put_public(b"hello").await?;
    let data = client.data_get_public(&result.address).await?;
    Ok(())
}
```

```cpp
// C++ — CMake FetchContent from GitHub
#include <antd/antd.hpp>

antd::Client client;                                       // REST, localhost:8082
antd::Client client("http://remote:8082");

auto result = client.dataPutPublic("hello");
auto data = client.dataGetPublic(result.address);
```

```ruby
# Ruby — gem install antd
require "antd"

client = Antd::Client.new                            # REST, localhost:8082
client = Antd::Client.new(base_url: "http://remote:8082")

result = client.data_put_public("hello")
data = client.data_get_public(result.address)
```

```php
// PHP — composer require autonomi/antd
<?php
use Autonomi\AntdClient;

$client = AntdClient::create();                      // REST, localhost:8082
$client = AntdClient::create("http://remote:8082");

$result = $client->dataPutPublic("hello");
$data = $client->dataGetPublic($result->address);
```

```dart
// Dart — dart pub add antd
import 'package:antd/antd.dart';

final client = AntdClient();                         // REST, localhost:8082
final client = AntdClient(baseUrl: 'http://remote:8082');

final result = await client.dataPutPublic('hello'.codeUnits);
final data = await client.dataGetPublic(result.address);
```

```lua
-- Lua — luarocks install antd
local antd = require("antd")

local client = antd.Client.new()                     -- REST, localhost:8082
local client = antd.Client.new({base_url = "http://remote:8082"})

local result = client:data_put_public("hello")
local data = client:data_get_public(result.address)
```

```elixir
# Elixir — {:antd, "~> 0.1"} in mix.exs deps
client = Antd.Client.new()                           # REST, localhost:8082
client = Antd.Client.new(base_url: "http://remote:8082")

{:ok, result} = Antd.Client.data_put_public(client, "hello")
{:ok, data} = Antd.Client.data_get_public(client, result.address)
```

```zig
// Zig — add dependency in build.zig.zon
const antd = @import("antd");

var client = try antd.Client.init(.{});              // REST, localhost:8082
defer client.deinit();

const result = try client.dataPutPublic("hello");
const data = try client.dataGetPublic(result.address);
```

---

## REST API — All Endpoints

### Health

#### `GET /health`
Returns daemon health, network name, build/EVM info, and a live
network-participation snapshot.

Response:
```json
{
  "status": "ok",
  "network": "local",
  "version": "0.12.0",
  "evm_network": "arbitrum-one",
  "uptime_seconds": 12345,
  "build_commit": "1cbfb3ec85ad",
  "payment_token_address": "0x...",
  "payment_vault_address": "0x...",
  "write_ready": true,
  "connected_peers": 10,
  "routing_table_size": 8,
  "rebootstrap_threshold": 3,
  "last_store_ok_secs_ago": 42
}
```

`write_ready` is a best-effort write-path signal:
`max(routing_table_size, connected_peers) >= rebootstrap_threshold`; `false`
means stores are known-degraded (e.g. the daemon has lost its peers) even
though `status` stays `"ok"` and cached reads may still succeed.
`last_store_ok_secs_ago` is `null` until the first successful store-type
operation in this process. The five network fields were added in antd 0.12.1;
older daemons omit them.

### Data

#### `POST /v1/data/public`
Store public (unencrypted) data on the network.

Request: `{"data": "<base64>", "payment_mode": "auto"}` (payment_mode is optional, defaults to "auto")
Response: `{"address": "<hex>", "chunks_stored": <uint>, "payment_mode_used": "auto|merkle|single"}`

#### `GET /v1/data/public/{addr}`
Retrieve public data by hex address.

Response: `{"data": "<base64>"}`

#### `GET /v1/data/public/{addr}/stream`
Stream public data as chunked response. Same path params as above.

#### `POST /v1/data/private`
Store private (encrypted) data. Returns a data map instead of address.

Request: `{"data": "<base64>", "payment_mode": "auto"}` (payment_mode is optional, defaults to "auto")
Response: `{"data_map": "<hex>", "chunks_stored": <uint>, "payment_mode_used": "auto|merkle|single"}`

#### `GET /v1/data/private`
Retrieve private data using data map.

Query params: `data_map=<hex>`
Response: `{"data": "<base64>"}`

#### `POST /v1/data/cost`
Estimate cost to store data. Samples up to 5 chunk addresses for the on-chain
quote, then extrapolates — much faster than quoting every chunk.

Request: `{"data": "<base64>"}`
Response: `{"cost": "<atto_tokens>", "file_size": <uint>, "chunk_count": <uint>, "estimated_gas_cost_wei": "<wei>", "payment_mode": "auto|merkle|single"}`

### Chunks

#### `POST /v1/chunks`
Store a raw chunk.

Request: `{"data": "<base64>"}`
Response: `{"cost": "<atto_tokens>", "address": "<hex>"}`

#### `GET /v1/chunks/{addr}`
Retrieve a raw chunk by hex address.

Response: `{"data": "<base64>"}`

### Files

Upload and download files/directories from the local filesystem.

#### `POST /v1/files/upload/public`
Upload a local file.

Request: `{"path": "/absolute/path/to/file", "payment_mode": "auto"}` (payment_mode is optional, defaults to "auto")
Response: `{"address": "<hex>", "storage_cost_atto": "<atto>", "gas_cost_wei": "<wei>", "chunks_stored": <uint>, "payment_mode_used": "auto|merkle|single"}`

#### `POST /v1/files/download/public`
Download a file to a local path.

Request: `{"address": "<hex>", "dest_path": "/absolute/path"}`

#### `POST /v1/files`
Upload a local file *privately*. Returns a caller-held DataMap; the DataMap is NOT stored on-network.

Request: `{"path": "/absolute/path/to/file", "payment_mode": "auto"}` (payment_mode is optional, defaults to "auto")
Response: `{"data_map": "<hex>", "storage_cost_atto": "<atto>", "gas_cost_wei": "<wei>", "chunks_stored": <uint>, "payment_mode_used": "auto|merkle|single"}`

#### `POST /v1/files/get`
Download a private file from a caller-held DataMap into a local path.

Request: `{"data_map": "<hex>", "dest_path": "/absolute/path"}`

#### `POST /v1/files/cost`
Estimate file upload cost. Samples up to 5 chunk addresses for the on-chain
quote, then extrapolates — much faster than quoting every chunk.

Request: `{"path": "/path/to/file", "is_public": true}` (`is_public` optional, defaults to true)
Response: `{"cost": "<atto_tokens>", "file_size": <uint>, "chunk_count": <uint>, "estimated_gas_cost_wei": "<wei>", "payment_mode": "auto|merkle|single"}`

#### `GET /v1/wallet/address`
Get the wallet's public address.

Response: `{"address": "0x..."}`
Returns 400 if no wallet is configured.

#### `GET /v1/wallet/balance`
Get the wallet's token and gas balances.

Response: `{"balance": "<atto_tokens>", "gas_balance": "<atto_tokens>"}`
Returns 400 if no wallet is configured.

#### `POST /v1/wallet/approve`
Approve the wallet to spend tokens on payment contracts (one-time operation before any storage).

Request: `{}` (empty body)
Response: `{"approved": true}`
Returns 400 if no wallet is configured.

#### `POST /v1/data/prepare`
Prepare a data upload for external signing (two-phase upload). Instead of antd paying
from its built-in wallet, this returns payment details for an external signer.

Request: `{"data": "base64-encoded-bytes"}`

The response includes a `payment_type` discriminator that determines the payment flow:

**Wave-batch response** (< 64 chunks — call `payForQuotes()`, finalize with `tx_hashes`):
```json
{
  "upload_id": "hex-string",
  "payment_type": "wave_batch",
  "payments": [
    { "quote_hash": "0x...", "rewards_address": "0x...", "amount": "123" }
  ],
  "total_amount": "456",
  "payment_vault_address": "0x...",
  "payment_token_address": "0x...",
  "rpc_url": "http://...",
  "total_chunks": 3,
  "already_stored_count": 1
}
```

`total_chunks` and `already_stored_count` were added in antd 0.10.0 (older daemons omit them; SDKs default both to 0). They report the already-stored preflight: the signer pays for `total_chunks - already_stored_count` chunks, so a prepare can legitimately come back cheaper than the raw file size implies.

**Merkle response** (>= 64 chunks — call `payForMerkleTree()`, finalize with `winner_pool_hash`):
```json
{
  "upload_id": "hex-string",
  "payment_type": "merkle",
  "depth": 5,
  "pool_commitments": [
    {
      "pool_hash": "0x...",
      "candidates": [
        { "rewards_address": "0x...", "amount": "1000" }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "merkle_payment_timestamp": 1712150400,
  "payment_vault_address": "0x...",
  "total_amount": "0",
  "payment_token_address": "0x...",
  "rpc_url": "http://...",
  "total_chunks": 128,
  "already_stored_count": 4
}
```

#### `POST /v1/upload/prepare`
Prepare a file upload for external signing. Same response format as `/v1/data/prepare`.

Request: `{"path": "/path/to/file"}`

#### `POST /v1/upload/finalize`
Finalize an upload after an external signer has submitted payment on-chain.
Provide either `tx_hashes` (wave_batch) or `winner_pool_hash` (merkle).

Wave-batch request: `{"upload_id": "hex", "tx_hashes": {"0xquotehash": "0xtxhash", ...}}`
Merkle request: `{"upload_id": "hex", "winner_pool_hash": "0x..."}`
Response: `{"data_map": "hex", "address": "hex", "chunks_stored": 5}`

#### `POST /v1/chunks/prepare`
Prepare a single-chunk upload for external signing. The bytes are stored
verbatim as one chunk at their BLAKE3 address — no self-encryption. Unlike
`POST /v1/chunks`, this handler does NOT require the daemon to have a wallet;
all funds flow through the external signer.

Request: `{"data": "<base64>"}`

When the chunk is already on-network (no payment needed, no finalize call):
```json
{ "address": "<hex>", "already_stored": true }
```

When payment is needed (wave_batch shape — `payForQuotes()` then call `/v1/chunks/finalize` with the resulting `tx_hashes`):
```json
{
  "address": "<hex>",
  "already_stored": false,
  "upload_id": "<hex>",
  "payment_type": "wave_batch",
  "payments": [
    { "quote_hash": "0x...", "rewards_address": "0x...", "amount": "123" }
  ],
  "total_amount": "456",
  "payment_vault_address": "0x...",
  "payment_token_address": "0x...",
  "rpc_url": "http://..."
}
```

#### `POST /v1/chunks/finalize`
Finalize a single-chunk upload after the external signer has paid the quotes
returned by `/v1/chunks/prepare`.

Request: `{"upload_id": "<hex>", "tx_hashes": {"0xquotehash": "0xtxhash", ...}}`
Response: `{"address": "<hex>"}`

### Pointers

A pointer is a small, owner-signed, mutable reference (ADR-0016 in ant-node).
Its address is derived from the owner's ML-DSA-65 key and never changes; what
it points at (a chunk, such as a public file's data map, or another pointer)
can be updated by the owner. Every state is paid for separately, about the
price of one chunk, and every attempt pays again: never retry a create, update
or transfer automatically.

antd signs with owner keys loaded at startup: `--pointer-keys <file-or-dir>`
(env `ANTD_POINTER_KEYS_DIR`). A key file is what `ant pointer keygen` writes —
a 32-byte seed, hex. Requests name the pointer by its address (`owner`), never
by a key; antd never returns, logs or persists keys.

Addresses, state ids and targets are 64 hex characters. Counters are decimal
strings: a final state sits at u64::MAX (18446744073709551615).

#### `GET /v1/pointers/keys`
The pointers this daemon can write. Response: `{"keys": [{"address": "<hex>"}]}`

#### `POST /v1/pointers`
Create a pointer, paid by the daemon wallet. `409 ALREADY_EXISTS` if it exists.
Request: `{"owner": "<hex>", "target": "<hex>", "kind": "chunk"}` (`kind`: `"chunk"` default, or `"pointer"`)
Response: `{"address": "<hex>", "state_id": "<hex>", "counter": "0"}`

#### `POST /v1/pointers/update`
Point a pointer at a new target, paid by the daemon wallet; creates it if it
does not exist. Same request and response as create. `409 POINTER_FINAL` if the
pointer has been transferred or frozen.

#### `POST /v1/pointers/transfer`
Hand a pointer over to the recipient's pointer, for good (ADR-0018). Readers of
the address are redirected to the recipient's pointer; the address stays the
same; the old key can change nothing. Irreversible once stored. Refused before
paying if the pointer is already final, the recipient does not exist or leads
back, or not every peer of the close group answered (`503 CLOSE_GROUP_SHORTFALL`,
free to retry).
Request: `{"owner": "<hex>", "recipient": "<hex>"}`
Response: `{"address": "<hex>", "state_id": "<hex>", "finality": {...} | null, "finality_error": "..."}`

#### `GET /v1/pointers/{addr}`
Response: `{"address", "owner": "<hex ML-DSA-65 public key>", "counter", "kind": "chunk|pointer|unknown", "kind_tag", "target", "state_id", "is_final": bool, "transferred_to": "<hex>" | null}`. `404` if no pointer.

#### `GET /v1/pointers/{addr}/resolve`
Follow a chain of pointers (at most 16 hops) to its end. Response: `{"kind", "kind_tag", "target"}`

#### `GET /v1/pointers/{addr}/finality`
Ask the whole close group where a pointer stands. Check this before relying on
a transfer: only `"final"` means one final state, held by a majority, no rival.
Response: `{"address", "group", "answered", "status": "open|settling|unconfirmed|final|forked", "counter" (open), "state" (settling/unconfirmed/final), "states" + "majority" (forked), "transferred_to"}`

#### `GET /v1/pointers/{addr}/controller`
Follow transfers to the pointer whose owner now decides. Response: `{"pointer", "transfers": [...], "frozen": bool}`

#### `POST /v1/pointers/prepare`
External signer: antd signs the write with its loaded key and quotes it; the
caller pays with `payForQuotes()`. Needs no daemon wallet.
Request: `{"owner": "<hex>", "op": "create|update|transfer", "target": "<hex>", "kind": "chunk", "recipient": "<hex>"}`
Response: `{"upload_id", "op", "address", "state_id", "counter", "payment_type": "wave_batch", "payments": [...], "total_amount", "payment_vault_address", "payment_token_address", "rpc_url"}`
While a prepared write is pending, other writes to that pointer answer `409 CONFLICT`.

#### `POST /v1/pointers/finalize`
Request: `{"upload_id": "<hex>", "tx_hashes": {"0xquotehash": "0xtxhash", ...}}`
Response: `{"address", "state_id", "counter", "finality": {...}}` (`finality` for transfers only)
A write that falls short after payment answers `503 CLOSE_GROUP_SHORTFALL` with
`"retryable": true` and keeps the paid state: repeat the finalize with the same
`upload_id` (tx_hashes ignored) to store it against the same payment.

Pointer error codes: `CLOSE_GROUP_SHORTFALL` (503; reads are free to retry),
`POINTER_FINAL` (409), `POINTER_FORKED` (409), `CONFLICT` (409),
`ALREADY_EXISTS` (409).

---

### Manifests (ADR-0006)

Stateless build and decode of `.ant` manifests and `ant://` links (needs the
antd release after 0.15.0). A manifest describes a set of files as one
document: each entry has an optional `path` and `size` and either an embedded
DataMap (a private file: the manifest is its key) or the address of a public
file. The format, content addresses and portable path rules come from
ant-core, so the same inputs give the `ant` CLI's exact bytes. **Nothing is
uploaded or paid for**, and the daemon needs no wallet. The network is read
only to resolve DataMaps (the embedding policy on build, `resolve` on decode),
so a call can time out; retrying is safe. Upload the files first
(`POST /v1/data`, `POST /v1/data/public`, `POST /v1/files`,
`POST /v1/files/public`) and build from the DataMaps and addresses they return.

#### `POST /v1/manifests/build`
Build a manifest from DataMaps (hex, embedded) and public addresses already in
hand. Each entry has **exactly one** of `data_map` (the hex a private upload
returns) or `address` (64 hex: a public file's DataMap address); both or
neither is a 400. `path` is a relative portable path (no `..`, no leading
slash, no empty component; unset or empty: the entry extracts under its content
address). `size` is recorded as given, the creator's claim; unset records none.
`name` is a suggested root directory name (one portable path component).
`torrent_info_hashes` are hex, 40 characters for v1 and/or 64 for v2.
`embed_roots` (default true): a shrunk DataMap is resolved and its root embedded
when the root is at most 64 KiB, as the `ant` CLI does, so readers skip that
fetch; `false` embeds DataMaps exactly as given.

Request:
```json
{
  "name": "album",
  "embed_roots": true,
  "torrent_info_hashes": [],
  "entries": [
    {"path": "photos/a.jpg", "data_map": "<hex>", "size": 123},
    {"path": "readme.txt", "address": "<64 hex>"}
  ]
}
```
Response (`manifest` is the base64 of the raw `.ant` bytes):
```json
{
  "manifest": "<base64 .ant>",
  "link": "ant://manifest/...",
  "entries": [
    {"effective_name": "photos/a.jpg", "path": "photos/a.jpg", "size": 123,
     "kind": "embedded", "content_address": "<64 hex>", "exact_size": 123},
    {"effective_name": "readme.txt", "path": "readme.txt",
     "kind": "public", "content_address": "<64 hex>"}
  ]
}
```
- `entries` come back in encoded order, sorted by `effective_name` (the path, or
  the content address in hex when there is no path), not in request order.
- `link` is present only when it fits 1,500 bytes; otherwise it is omitted and
  the `.ant` bytes (`manifest`) are what you share.
- Unset fields are omitted: `size` when none was recorded, `exact_size` when
  unknown (an embedded root DataMap carries it, so embedded entries have it
  after `embed_roots`), `path` when there is none. Never `0` for unset: `0` is
  an empty file.
- `content_address` is the file's public DataMap address, the same for a private
  and a public upload of one file.

#### `POST /v1/manifests/decode`
Decode a manifest. Give exactly one of `manifest` (base64 `.ant` bytes) or
`link` (`ant://manifest/...`, an `ant://<address>` file link, or a bare 64-hex
address); both or neither is a 400.
Request: `{"manifest": "<base64 .ant>", "resolve": false}` or `{"link": "ant://manifest/...", "resolve": true}`

`resolve` (default false) fetches each entry's DataMap, and its wrapper
records, to report `exact_size` and confirm the DataMap is on the network.
Content chunks are not fetched. One entry's failure is reported in that entry's
`error` and `exact_size` stays unset; it does not fail the call.

Response:
```json
{
  "source": "manifest",
  "name": "album",
  "torrent_info_hash_v1": "<40 hex>",
  "torrent_info_hash_v2": "<64 hex>",
  "entries": [
    {"effective_name": "photos/a.jpg", "path": "photos/a.jpg", "size": 123,
     "kind": "embedded", "content_address": "<64 hex>",
     "data_map": "<hex>", "exact_size": 123},
    {"effective_name": "readme.txt", "path": "readme.txt", "kind": "public",
     "content_address": "<64 hex>", "exact_size": 40}
  ]
}
```
- `source` is `"manifest"`, or `"file_link"` for a file link or bare address,
  which decodes as one public entry with no path and no `name`.
- Embedded entries carry `data_map` in the hex form the download routes accept
  (`POST /v1/data/get`, `POST /v1/files/get`). Public entries have none: use
  `content_address` with `GET /v1/data/public/{addr}` or
  `POST /v1/files/public/get`.
- `name` and the torrent hashes are omitted when absent.

Limits: a manifest is at most 64 MiB and 100,000 entries; each `data_map` at
most 10 MiB; request bodies at most 100 MiB. A link is recommended at no more
than 1,500 bytes; past that `link` is omitted. Error messages list up to 20
bad entries.

Errors: there are no manifest-specific codes. An invalid entry or input is
`400 BAD_REQUEST` (gRPC INVALID_ARGUMENT) with a message that names every bad
entry, e.g. `2 invalid entries: entries[0]: invalid path "../x": ...;
entries[1]: give data_map or address, not both` (at most 20 shown, then `; and K
more`; REST prefixes `Bad request: `). Every SDK raises its bad-request error (status
400) for these, including the both-or-neither check it makes before sending and
an empty decode input (`needs a manifest (base64 .ant bytes) or a link`), with the
same text. Bad base64, a manifest that does not parse, and an invalid
link are 400s too.

Per-SDK methods (`build_manifest`, `decode_manifest`, `decode_manifest_link`,
cased per language) are listed in each SDK's section below. Every SDK has them,
over gRPC too in C++, C#, Dart, Elixir, Go, Java, Kotlin, Python, Ruby, Rust and
Swift; JS/TS, Lua, PHP and Zig are REST only. They take and return the raw
`.ant` bytes: base64 is only the REST wire form. The MCP server has
`build_manifest` and `decode_manifest` tools (free; no confirmation needed).
Tutorial: [docs/tutorial-manifests.md](docs/tutorial-manifests.md).

---

## gRPC API — All Services

Default target: `localhost:50051`. Package: `antd.v1`.

### HealthService (health.proto)
- `Check(HealthCheckRequest) → HealthCheckResponse` — returns status, network name, version/build/EVM info, and the live network snapshot (`write_ready`, `connected_peers`, `routing_table_size`, `rebootstrap_threshold`, `last_store_ok_secs_ago`) — same semantics as REST `GET /health`

### DataService (data.proto)
- `GetPublic(GetPublicDataRequest{address}) → GetPublicDataResponse{data: bytes}`
- `PutPublic(PutPublicDataRequest{data: bytes}) → PutPublicDataResponse{cost, address}`
- `StreamPublic(StreamPublicDataRequest{address}) → stream DataChunk{data: bytes}`
- `GetPrivate(GetPrivateDataRequest{data_map}) → GetPrivateDataResponse{data: bytes}`
- `PutPrivate(PutPrivateDataRequest{data: bytes}) → PutPrivateDataResponse{cost, data_map}`
- `GetCost(DataCostRequest{data: bytes}) → Cost{atto_tokens, file_size, chunk_count, estimated_gas_cost_wei, payment_mode}`

### ChunkService (chunks.proto)
- `Get(GetChunkRequest{address}) → GetChunkResponse{data: bytes}`
- `Put(PutChunkRequest{data: bytes}) → PutChunkResponse{cost, address}`

### FileService (files.proto)
- `UploadPublic(UploadFileRequest{path}) → UploadPublicResponse{cost, address}`
- `DownloadPublic(DownloadPublicRequest{address, dest_path}) → DownloadResponse{}`
- `GetFileCost(FileCostRequest{path, is_public}) → Cost{atto_tokens, file_size, chunk_count, estimated_gas_cost_wei, payment_mode}`

### EventService (events.proto)
- `Subscribe(SubscribeRequest{}) → stream ClientEventProto{kind, records_paid, records_already_paid, tokens_spent}`

### PointerService (pointers.proto)
Mirrors REST `/v1/pointers` 1:1; counters are decimal strings, unset values are empty strings.
- `ListKeys` · `Create` / `Update(PointerWriteRequest{owner, target, kind})` · `Transfer(PointerTransferRequest{owner, recipient})`
- `Get` → `PointerRecord` · `Resolve` → `PointerResolved` · `Finality` → `PointerFinality` · `Controller` → `PointerController`
- `Prepare(PreparePointerRequest{owner, op, target, kind, recipient})` / `Finalize(FinalizePointerRequest{upload_id, tx_hashes})`
- Errors: `POINTER_FINAL` / `POINTER_FORKED` → FAILED_PRECONDITION, `CONFLICT` → ABORTED, `CLOSE_GROUP_SHORTFALL` → UNAVAILABLE

### ManifestService (manifests.proto)
Mirrors REST `/v1/manifests` 1:1; the `.ant` bytes are raw `bytes` here (base64 only on REST), and optional values use proto3 `optional` (check presence, not the zero value). Both calls are unary and free.
- `Build(BuildManifestRequest{name?, torrent_info_hashes, embed_roots?, entries[{path?, size?, data_map | address}]}) → BuildManifestResponse{manifest: bytes, link, entries}`: `embed_roots` unset means true; `link` is empty when it would pass 1,500 bytes
- `Decode(DecodeManifestRequest{manifest: bytes | link, resolve}) → DecodeManifestResponse{source, name?, torrent_info_hash_v1, torrent_info_hash_v2, entries}`
- `ManifestEntryInfo{effective_name, path?, size?, kind, content_address, data_map, exact_size?, error}`: `data_map` is empty for public entries and on build; `error` is empty unless `resolve` failed for that entry
- A manifest can be 64 MiB and the server accepts requests up to 100 MiB, so clients raise their receive (and send) limit for these calls: the SDKs set 256 MiB, per call where the gRPC library allows it, otherwise on a second channel for the manifest service
- Errors: invalid entry or input → INVALID_ARGUMENT, with the same `entries[i]` message as REST

### SDKs with gRPC support
Go, Python, C#, Kotlin, Swift, Rust, Java, C++, Dart, Ruby, Elixir (11 of 15 SDKs).
JS/TS, PHP, Lua, and Zig are REST-only.

---

## Model Types

### Common (both SDKs)

| Type | Fields | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| HealthStatus | ok: bool, network: string | Health check result |
| PutResult | cost: string, address: string | Result from any create/put operation |
| UploadCostEstimate | cost: string, file_size: u64, chunk_count: u32, estimated_gas_cost_wei: string, payment_mode: string | Pre-upload cost breakdown returned by data_cost / file_cost. Server samples up to 5 chunk addresses and extrapolates; gas is an advisory heuristic. |

### Pointers

Wire field names; each SDK cases them idiomatically. Counters are decimal strings on the wire, parsed into an exact unsigned 64-bit value (or kept as a checked string in Lua and PHP). Unset values are `null` over REST and `""` or an absent message over gRPC; SDKs map both to their "none".

| Type | Fields | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| PointerWriteResult | address, state_id, counter | The state a create or update stored |
| PointerRecord | address, owner (ML-DSA-65 public key, hex), counter, kind, kind_tag, target, state_id, is_final, transferred_to | A pointer's current state |
| PointerTarget | kind, kind_tag, target | Where a chain of pointers ends (`PointerResolved` in Rust) |
| PointerFinality | address, group, answered, status, counter, state, states, majority, transferred_to | The close group's view; `status` is open / settling / unconfirmed / final / forked, plus an unknown case for statuses a newer daemon adds |
| PointerController | pointer, transfers, frozen | Whose pointer decides, after every transfer |
| PointerTransferResult | address, state_id, finality, finality_error | What a transfer stored |
| PointerPrepareResult | upload_id, op, address, state_id, counter, payment_type, payments, total_amount, payment_vault_address, payment_token_address, rpc_url | A signed pointer write quoted for an external signer (always `wave_batch`) |
| PointerFinalizeResult | address, state_id, counter, finality | What a pointer finalize stored (`finality` for a transfer) |

### Manifests

Wire field names; each SDK cases them idiomatically. Sizes are optional unsigned 64-bit values (or the SDK's usual file-size type): unset is the language's none, never `0`.

| Type | Fields | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| ManifestEntryInput | path?, size?, data_map \| address | One file to build from: exactly one of `data_map` (hex, embedded) or `address` (hex, public); both or neither is refused before sending, as the SDK's bad-request error (status 400) |
| BuildManifestOptions | name?, torrent_info_hashes, embed_roots (default true) | Go, Java, C++ and Rust spell the last as `KeepShrunkDataMaps` / `keepShrunkDataMaps` / `keep_shrunk_data_maps` (default false) |
| ManifestEntryInfo | effective_name, path?, size?, kind ("embedded" \| "public"), content_address, data_map, exact_size?, error | What a manifest says about one entry; `data_map` on decode only, `exact_size` and `error` set by `resolve` (or an embedded root) |
| BuiltManifest | manifest (raw `.ant` bytes), link, entries | `link` is empty or none when it would pass 1,500 bytes; entries are sorted by effective name |
| DecodedManifest | source ("manifest" \| "file_link"), name?, torrent_info_hash_v1, torrent_info_hash_v2, entries | A decoded manifest or file link |

---

## Payment Modes

All data and file upload operations accept an optional `payment_mode` parameter that controls how storage payments are batched:

| Mode | Behavior |
|------|----------|
| `"auto"` (default) | Uses merkle batch payments for uploads of 64+ chunks, single payments otherwise. Best for general use. |
| `"merkle"` | Forces merkle batch payments regardless of chunk count (minimum 2 chunks). Saves gas on larger uploads. |
| `"single"` | Forces per-chunk payments. Useful for small data or debugging. |

This applies to all PUT endpoints (`data_put_public`, `data_put_private`, `file_upload_public`) across all SDKs. The parameter is always optional and defaults to `"auto"`.

**REST:** Include `"payment_mode": "merkle"` in the JSON request body.

**SDK examples:**
```python
# Python
result = client.data_put_public(data, payment_mode="merkle")
```
```go
// Go
result, err := client.DataPutPublic(ctx, data, antd.WithPaymentMode("merkle"))
```
```typescript
// TypeScript
const result = await client.dataPutPublic(data, { paymentMode: "merkle" });
```

## JS/TS SDK Method Signatures

```typescript
import { createClient } from "@withautonomi/antd";

const client = createClient();                                  // REST, localhost:8082
const client = createClient({ baseUrl: "http://remote:8082" }); // custom URL
const client = createClient({ timeout: 60_000 });               // custom timeout (ms)

// Health
client.health(): Promise<HealthStatus>

// Data
client.dataPutPublic(data: Buffer, opts?: { paymentMode?: PaymentMode }): Promise<DataPutPublicResult>
client.dataGetPublic(address: string): Promise<Buffer>
client.dataPut(data: Buffer, opts?: { paymentMode?: PaymentMode }): Promise<DataPutResult>
client.dataGet(dataMap: string): Promise<Buffer>
client.dataCost(data: Buffer, opts?: { paymentMode?: PaymentMode }): Promise<UploadCostEstimate>

// Chunks
client.chunkPut(data: Buffer): Promise<PutResult>
client.chunkGet(address: string): Promise<Buffer>

// Files
client.filePut(path: string, opts?: { paymentMode?: PaymentMode }): Promise<FilePutResult>
client.fileGet(dataMap: string, destPath: string): Promise<void>
client.filePutPublic(path: string, opts?: { paymentMode?: PaymentMode }): Promise<FilePutPublicResult>
client.fileGetPublic(address: string, destPath: string): Promise<void>
client.fileCost(path: string, isPublic?: boolean, opts?: { paymentMode?: PaymentMode }): Promise<UploadCostEstimate>

// Wallet
// Manifests (REST; free: nothing is uploaded or paid for; sizes are number, unset values null; bytes are Buffer)
client.buildManifest(entries: ManifestEntryInput[], opts?: { name?: string; torrentInfoHashes?: string[]; embedRoots?: boolean }): Promise<BuiltManifest>
client.decodeManifest(manifest: Buffer | Uint8Array, resolve?: boolean): Promise<DecodedManifest>
client.decodeManifestLink(link: string, resolve?: boolean): Promise<DecodedManifest>

client.walletAddress(): Promise<WalletAddress>
client.walletBalance(): Promise<WalletBalance>
client.walletApprove(): Promise<boolean>

// Pointers (REST; counters are bigint, unset values null; every write pays and is never retried)
client.pointerKeys(): Promise<string[]>
client.pointerCreate(owner: string, target: string, kind?: PointerKind): Promise<PointerWriteResult>
client.pointerUpdate(owner: string, target: string, kind?: PointerKind): Promise<PointerWriteResult>
client.pointerTransfer(owner: string, recipient: string): Promise<PointerTransferResult>  // irreversible
client.pointerGet(address: string): Promise<PointerRecord>
client.pointerResolve(address: string): Promise<PointerTarget>
client.pointerFinality(address: string): Promise<PointerFinality>
client.pointerController(address: string): Promise<PointerController>
client.pointerPrepare(owner: string, op: PointerOp, options?: { includeSignedQuotes?: boolean }): Promise<PointerPrepareResult>
client.pointerFinalize(uploadId: string, txHashes: Record<string, string>): Promise<PointerFinalizeResult>
```

## Python SDK Method Signatures

```python
from antd import AntdClient, AsyncAntdClient

client = AntdClient(transport="rest", base_url="http://localhost:8082")
client = AntdClient(transport="grpc", target="localhost:50051")

# Health
client.health() → HealthStatus

# Data
client.data_put_public(data: bytes, payment_mode: PaymentMode = PaymentMode.AUTO) → DataPutPublicResult
client.data_get_public(address: str) → bytes
client.data_put(data: bytes, payment_mode: PaymentMode = PaymentMode.AUTO) → DataPutResult
client.data_get(data_map: str) → bytes
client.data_cost(data: bytes, payment_mode: PaymentMode = PaymentMode.AUTO) → UploadCostEstimate

# Chunks
client.chunk_put(data: bytes) → PutResult
client.chunk_get(address: str) → bytes

# Files
client.file_put(path: str, payment_mode: PaymentMode = PaymentMode.AUTO) → FilePutResult
client.file_get(data_map: str, dest_path: str) → None
client.file_put_public(path: str, payment_mode: PaymentMode = PaymentMode.AUTO) → FilePutPublicResult
client.file_get_public(address: str, dest_path: str) → None
client.file_cost(path: str, is_public: bool = True, payment_mode: PaymentMode = PaymentMode.AUTO) → UploadCostEstimate

# Wallet
# Manifests (REST + gRPC, sync and async; free; sizes are int, unset is None; bytes are bytes)
client.build_manifest(entries: list[ManifestEntryInput], *, name=None, torrent_info_hashes=None, embed_roots=True) → BuiltManifest
client.decode_manifest(manifest: bytes, resolve: bool = False) → DecodedManifest
client.decode_manifest_link(link: str, resolve: bool = False) → DecodedManifest

client.wallet_address() → WalletAddress
client.wallet_balance() → WalletBalance
client.wallet_approve() → bool

# Pointers (REST + gRPC; counters are int; every write pays and is never retried)
client.pointer_keys() → list[str]
client.pointer_create(owner: str, target: str, kind: PointerKind = PointerKind.CHUNK) → PointerWriteResult
client.pointer_update(owner: str, target: str, kind: PointerKind = PointerKind.CHUNK) → PointerWriteResult
client.pointer_transfer(owner: str, recipient: str) → PointerTransferResult  # irreversible
client.pointer_get(address: str) → PointerRecord
client.pointer_resolve(address: str) → PointerTarget
client.pointer_finality(address: str) → PointerFinality
client.pointer_controller(address: str) → PointerController
client.pointer_prepare(owner: str, op: PointerOp, *, target=None, kind=None, recipient=None, include_signed_quotes=False) → PointerPrepareResult
client.pointer_finalize(upload_id: str, tx_hashes: dict[str, str]) → PointerFinalizeResult
```

## Java SDK Method Signatures

```java
// Gradle: implementation("com.autonomi:antd-java:0.1.0")
// Maven:  <dependency><groupId>com.autonomi</groupId><artifactId>antd-java</artifactId><version>0.1.0</version></dependency>
import com.autonomi.antd.AntdClient;

AntdClient client = AntdClient.create();                  // REST, localhost:8082
AntdClient client = AntdClient.create("http://remote:8082");

// Health
HealthStatus health() throws AntdException

// Data
DataPutPublicResult dataPutPublic(byte[] data, PaymentMode paymentMode) throws AntdException
byte[] dataGetPublic(String address) throws AntdException
DataPutResult dataPut(byte[] data, PaymentMode paymentMode) throws AntdException
byte[] dataGet(String dataMap) throws AntdException
UploadCostEstimate dataCost(byte[] data, PaymentMode paymentMode) throws AntdException

// Chunks
PutResult chunkPut(byte[] data) throws AntdException
byte[] chunkGet(String address) throws AntdException

// Files
FilePutResult filePut(String path, PaymentMode paymentMode) throws AntdException
void fileGet(String dataMap, String destPath) throws AntdException
FilePutPublicResult filePutPublic(String path, PaymentMode paymentMode) throws AntdException
void fileGetPublic(String address, String destPath) throws AntdException
UploadCostEstimate fileCost(String path, boolean isPublic, PaymentMode paymentMode) throws AntdException

// Wallet
// Manifests (REST + gRPC; free; sizes are Long, unset is null; bytes are byte[])
BuiltManifest buildManifest(List<ManifestEntryInput> entries[, BuildManifestOptions options]) throws AntdException  // ManifestEntryInput.ofDataMap(...) / .ofAddress(...); options keepShrunkDataMaps
DecodedManifest decodeManifest(byte[] manifest, boolean resolve) throws AntdException
DecodedManifest decodeManifestLink(String link, boolean resolve) throws AntdException

WalletAddress walletAddress() throws AntdException
WalletBalance walletBalance() throws AntdException
boolean walletApprove() throws AntdException

// Pointers (REST + gRPC; counters are BigInteger; every write pays and is never retried)
List<String> pointerKeys() throws AntdException
PointerWriteResult pointerCreate(String owner, String target[, PointerTargetKind kind]) throws AntdException
PointerWriteResult pointerUpdate(String owner, String target[, PointerTargetKind kind]) throws AntdException
PointerTransferResult pointerTransfer(String owner, String recipient) throws AntdException  // irreversible
PointerRecord pointerGet(String address) throws AntdException
PointerTarget pointerResolve(String address) throws AntdException
PointerFinality pointerFinality(String address) throws AntdException
PointerController pointerController(String address) throws AntdException
PointerPrepareResult pointerPrepare(String owner, PointerOp op[, PointerPrepareOptions options]) throws AntdException
PointerFinalizeResult pointerFinalize(String uploadId, Map<String, String> txHashes) throws AntdException

// AntdClient implements AutoCloseable — use try-with-resources
```

## Rust SDK Method Signatures

```rust
// cargo add antd-client
use antd_client::{Client, PutResult, HealthStatus, AntdError};

let client = Client::new("http://localhost:8082");        // REST, localhost:8082

// Health
async fn health(&self) -> Result<HealthStatus, AntdError>

// Data
async fn data_put_public(&self, data: &[u8], payment_mode: PaymentMode) -> Result<DataPutPublicResult, AntdError>
async fn data_get_public(&self, address: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AntdError>
async fn data_put(&self, data: &[u8], payment_mode: PaymentMode) -> Result<DataPutResult, AntdError>
async fn data_get(&self, data_map: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AntdError>
async fn data_cost(&self, data: &[u8], payment_mode: PaymentMode) -> Result<UploadCostEstimate, AntdError>

// Chunks
async fn chunk_put(&self, data: &[u8]) -> Result<PutResult, AntdError>
async fn chunk_get(&self, address: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AntdError>

// Files
async fn file_put(&self, path: &str, payment_mode: PaymentMode) -> Result<FilePutResult, AntdError>
async fn file_get(&self, data_map: &str, dest_path: &str) -> Result<(), AntdError>
async fn file_put_public(&self, path: &str, payment_mode: PaymentMode) -> Result<FilePutPublicResult, AntdError>
async fn file_get_public(&self, address: &str, dest_path: &str) -> Result<(), AntdError>
async fn file_cost(&self, path: &str, is_public: bool, payment_mode: PaymentMode) -> Result<UploadCostEstimate, AntdError>

// Wallet
// Manifests (REST + gRPC; free; sizes are Option<u64>, unset is None; bytes are Vec<u8>)
async fn build_manifest(&self, entries: &[ManifestEntryInput]) -> Result<BuiltManifest, AntdError>  // also build_manifest_with_options(entries, &BuildManifestOptions { keep_shrunk_data_maps, .. })
async fn decode_manifest(&self, manifest: &[u8], resolve: bool) -> Result<DecodedManifest, AntdError>
async fn decode_manifest_link(&self, link: &str, resolve: bool) -> Result<DecodedManifest, AntdError>

async fn wallet_address(&self) -> Result<WalletAddress, AntdError>
async fn wallet_balance(&self) -> Result<WalletBalance, AntdError>
async fn wallet_approve(&self) -> Result<bool, AntdError>

// Pointers (REST + gRPC; counters are u64; every write pays and is never retried)
async fn pointer_keys(&self) -> Result<Vec<PointerKey>, AntdError>
async fn pointer_create(&self, owner: &str, target: &str, kind: PointerKind) -> Result<PointerWriteResult, AntdError>
async fn pointer_update(&self, owner: &str, target: &str, kind: PointerKind) -> Result<PointerWriteResult, AntdError>
async fn pointer_transfer(&self, owner: &str, recipient: &str) -> Result<PointerTransferResult, AntdError>  // irreversible
async fn pointer_get(&self, address: &str) -> Result<PointerRecord, AntdError>
async fn pointer_resolve(&self, address: &str) -> Result<PointerResolved, AntdError>
async fn pointer_finality(&self, address: &str) -> Result<PointerFinality, AntdError>
async fn pointer_controller(&self, address: &str) -> Result<PointerController, AntdError>
async fn pointer_prepare(&self, owner: &str, op: &PointerOp) -> Result<PointerPrepareResult, AntdError>  // also pointer_prepare_with_options
async fn pointer_finalize(&self, upload_id: &str, tx_hashes: &HashMap<String, String>) -> Result<PointerFinalizeResult, AntdError>

// AntdError variants: BadRequest, Payment, NotFound, AlreadyExists, Fork, TooLarge, Internal, Network,
// plus PointerFinal, PointerForked, Conflict and CloseGroupShortfall { retryable, .. } for pointers
```

```cpp
// CMake FetchContent from GitHub
#include <antd/antd.hpp>

antd::Client client;                                      // REST, localhost:8082

// Data

std::vector<uint8_t> chunkGet(const std::string& address)

void fileGet(const std::string& dataMap, const std::string& destPath)

UploadCostEstimate fileCost(const std::string& path, bool isPublic = true, antd::PaymentMode paymentMode = antd::PaymentMode::Auto)

// Wallet
// Manifests (REST + gRPC, sync and async; free; sizes are std::optional<std::uint64_t>; bytes are std::vector<uint8_t>)
antd::BuiltManifest build_manifest(const std::vector<antd::ManifestEntryInput>& entries, const antd::BuildManifestOptions& options = {})  // options.keep_shrunk_data_maps
antd::DecodedManifest decode_manifest(const std::vector<uint8_t>& manifest, bool resolve = false)

antd::WalletAddress walletAddress()
antd::WalletBalance walletBalance()
bool walletApprove()

// Pointers (REST + gRPC; snake_case; counters are std::uint64_t; every write pays and is never retried)
std::vector<antd::PointerKey> pointer_keys()

antd::PointerWriteResult pointer_update(std::string_view owner, std::string_view target, antd::PointerKind kind = antd::PointerKind::Chunk)
antd::PointerTransferResult pointer_transfer(std::string_view owner, std::string_view recipient)  // irreversible
antd::PointerRecord pointer_get(std::string_view address)
antd::PointerTarget pointer_resolve(std::string_view address)
antd::PointerFinality pointer_finality(std::string_view address)
antd::PointerController pointer_controller(std::string_view address)
antd::PointerPrepareResult pointer_prepare(const antd::PointerPrepareRequest& req)
antd::PointerFinalizeResult pointer_finalize(std::string_view upload_id, const std::map<std::string, std::string>& tx_hashes)

// All methods throw antd::AntdError or subclasses: BadRequestError, PaymentError, NotFoundError,
// AlreadyExistsError, ForkError, TooLargeError, InternalError, NetworkError, and for pointers
// PointerFinalError, PointerForkedError, ConflictError, CloseGroupShortfallError
```

```ruby
client = Antd::Client.new                            # localhost:8082

client.data_put_public(data, payment_mode: :auto) → DataPutPublicResult

client.chunk_get(address) → String

# Files

client.file_get(data_map, dest_path) → nil
client.file_put_public(path, payment_mode: :auto) → FilePutPublicResult
client.file_get_public(address, dest_path) → nil

client.decode_manifest_link(link, resolve: false) → DecodedManifest

client.pointer_update(owner, target, kind: nil) → PointerWriteResult
client.pointer_transfer(owner, recipient) → PointerTransferResult  # irreversible
client.pointer_get(address) → PointerRecord
client.pointer_resolve(address) → PointerTarget
client.pointer_finality(address) → PointerFinality
client.pointer_controller(address) → PointerController
client.pointer_prepare(owner, op, target: nil, kind: nil, recipient: nil, include_signed_quotes: false) → PointerPrepareResult
client.pointer_finalize(upload_id, tx_hashes) → PointerFinalizeResult
```

```php
$client->chunkGet(string $address): string

$client->decodeManifest(string $manifest, bool $resolve = false): DecodedManifest
$client->decodeManifestLink(string $link, bool $resolve = false): DecodedManifest

$client->walletBalance(): array{balance: string, gas_balance: string}

$client->pointerResolve(string $address): PointerTarget
$client->pointerFinality(string $address): PointerFinality
$client->pointerController(string $address): PointerController

$client->pointerFinalize(string $uploadId, array $txHashes): PointerFinalizeResult
```

## Lua SDK Method Signatures

```lua
local antd = require("antd")

local client = antd.Client.new()                     -- localhost:8082
local client = antd.Client.new({base_url = "http://remote:8082"})

-- Health
client:health() → HealthStatus

-- Data
client:data_put_public(data, payment_mode) → DataPutPublicResult (table)
client:data_get_public(address) → string
client:data_put(data, payment_mode) → DataPutResult (table)
client:data_get(data_map) → string
client:data_cost(data, payment_mode) → UploadCostEstimate (table)

-- Chunks
client:chunk_put(data) → PutResult
client:chunk_get(address) → string

-- Files
client:file_put(path, payment_mode) → FilePutResult (table)
client:file_get(data_map, dest_path) → nil
client:file_put_public(path, payment_mode) → FilePutPublicResult (table)
client:file_get_public(address, dest_path) → nil
client:file_cost(path, is_public, payment_mode) → UploadCostEstimate (table)

-- Wallet
-- Manifests (REST; free; sizes are numbers, unset is nil; bytes are Lua strings; entries are {path, size, data_map | address})
client:build_manifest(entries, opts) → {manifest, link, entries} | nil, err  -- opts: {name, torrent_info_hashes, embed_roots}
client:decode_manifest(bytes, resolve) → {source, name, torrent_info_hash_v1, torrent_info_hash_v2, entries} | nil, err
client:decode_manifest_link(link, resolve) → same

client:wallet_address() → {address=string}
client:wallet_balance() → {balance=string, gas_balance=string}
client:wallet_approve() → boolean

-- Pointers (REST; counters are checked decimal strings; every write pays and is never retried)
client:pointer_keys() → {string, ...}
client:pointer_create(owner, target, kind) → {address, state_id, counter}
client:pointer_update(owner, target, kind) → {address, state_id, counter}
client:pointer_transfer(owner, recipient) → {address, state_id, finality, finality_error}  -- irreversible
client:pointer_get(address) → PointerRecord (table)
client:pointer_resolve(address) → {kind, kind_tag, target}
client:pointer_finality(address) → PointerFinality (table)
client:pointer_controller(address) → {pointer, transfers, frozen}
client:pointer_prepare(owner, op, opts) → PointerPrepareResult (table)  -- op from antd.pointer_create_op / pointer_update_op / pointer_transfer_op
client:pointer_finalize(upload_id, tx_hashes) → {address, state_id, counter, finality}
```

```elixir
Antd.Client.wallet_approve(client) :: {:ok, boolean()} | {:error, term()}

Antd.Client.pointer_get(client, address) :: {:ok, Antd.PointerRecord.t()} | {:error, term()}
Antd.Client.pointer_resolve(client, address) :: {:ok, Antd.PointerTarget.t()} | {:error, term()}
Antd.Client.pointer_finality(client, address) :: {:ok, Antd.PointerFinality.t()} | {:error, term()}
Antd.Client.pointer_controller(client, address) :: {:ok, Antd.PointerController.t()} | {:error, term()}

Antd.Client.pointer_finalize(client, upload_id, tx_hashes) :: {:ok, Antd.PointerFinalizeResult.t()} | {:error, term()}
```

```zig
fn pointerResolve(self: *Client, address: []const u8) !PointerTarget
fn pointerFinality(self: *Client, address: []const u8) !PointerFinality
fn pointerController(self: *Client, address: []const u8) !PointerController

fn pointerFinalize(self: *Client, upload_id: []const u8, tx_hashes_json: []const u8) !PointerFinalizeResult
```

---

## External Signer SDK Methods

Every SDK exposes a two-phase external-signer flow that lets the caller pay on-chain themselves (via wallet, hardware key, or custodial signer) instead of antd paying from its built-in wallet. The flow is always `prepare → external sign+pay → finalize`.

| SDK method | Prepares for | REST route | Wave-batch finalize | Merkle finalize |
|------------|--------------|------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| `prepare_data_upload(data, visibility?)` | private/public data put | `POST /v1/data/prepare` | `finalize_upload(id, tx_hashes)` | `finalize_merkle_upload(id, winner_pool_hash)` |
| `prepare_upload(path, visibility?)` | private file put | `POST /v1/upload/prepare` | `finalize_upload` | `finalize_merkle_upload` |
| `prepare_upload_public(path)` | public file put (DataMap stored on-network at finalize) | `POST /v1/upload/prepare` (visibility = "public") | `finalize_upload` | `finalize_merkle_upload` |
| `prepare_chunk_upload(data)` | single-chunk publish (no self-encryption) | `POST /v1/chunks/prepare` | `finalize_chunk_upload(id, tx_hashes)` | n/a — single chunks never trigger merkle |

Reference signatures (Python; same method names exist on every SDK with idiomatic casing — `prepareUpload` / `PrepareUpload` etc.):

```python
client.prepare_data_upload(data: bytes, visibility: str | None = None) → PrepareUploadResult
client.prepare_upload(path: str, visibility: str | None = None) → PrepareUploadResult
client.prepare_upload_public(path: str) → PrepareUploadResult
client.prepare_chunk_upload(data: bytes) → PrepareChunkResult
client.finalize_upload(upload_id: str, tx_hashes: dict[str, str]) → FinalizeUploadResult
client.finalize_merkle_upload(upload_id: str, winner_pool_hash: str, store_data_map: bool = False) → FinalizeUploadResult
client.finalize_chunk_upload(upload_id: str, tx_hashes: dict[str, str]) → str  # returns the chunk address
```

`PrepareUploadResult` and `PrepareChunkResult` both carry the `payment_type` discriminator the REST endpoints emit (`"wave_batch"` or `"merkle"`); SDKs surface it directly so the caller can branch on which finalize to call. For full payment-shape detail see the `/v1/data/prepare`, `/v1/upload/prepare`, and `/v1/chunks/prepare` REST entries above. `PrepareChunkResult` additionally exposes `already_stored: bool` for the no-payment-needed path.

All 15 SDKs expose these methods (REST-only SDKs included — they call the same endpoints).

Pointer writes have their own pair, also in all 15 SDKs: `pointer_prepare(owner, op, ...)` (`POST /v1/pointers/prepare`) has antd sign a create, update or transfer with the owner key it holds and quote it, always as a `wave_batch` payment for `payForQuotes()`; `pointer_finalize(upload_id, tx_hashes)` (`POST /v1/pointers/finalize`) stores it once paid. While a prepared write awaits payment (up to an hour), other writes to that pointer answer `409 CONFLICT`. A finalize that falls short after payment answers `503 CLOSE_GROUP_SHORTFALL` with `retryable: true`: repeat it with the same `upload_id` to store against the same payment.

---

## MCP Tool → SDK Method Mapping

Every tool with a `private` flag (`store_data`, `retrieve_data`, `upload_file`, `download_file`) picks the public method by default and switches to the private variant when `private=True`. The returned `address` carries either the on-network address (public) or the caller-held DataMap (private) — same field, different shape, so agents can round-trip the value back through the matching retrieve/download tool without renaming fields.

| MCP Tool | Python SDK Method | Description |
|----------|-------------------|-------------|
| `store_data(text, private?, payment_mode?)` | `data_put_public` / `data_put` | Store text on the network. Private store returns the caller-held DataMap in `address`. |
| `retrieve_data(address, private?)` | `data_get_public` / `data_get` | Retrieve text. Pass `private=True` if `address` is a caller-held DataMap from a private store. |
| `upload_file(path, private?, payment_mode?)` | `file_put_public` / `file_put` | Upload a local file. Private upload returns the caller-held DataMap in `address`. |
| `download_file(address, dest_path, private?)` | `file_get_public` / `file_get` | Download a file. Pass `private=True` if `address` is a caller-held DataMap from a private upload. |
| `chunk_put` | `chunk_put` | Store raw chunk |
| `chunk_get` | `chunk_get` | Retrieve raw chunk |
| `get_cost(text?, file_path?, payment_mode?)` | `data_cost` / `file_cost` | Estimate storage cost. `payment_mode` flows through so the quote matches the eventual put. |
| `check_balance` | `health` | Check daemon health |
| `wallet_address` | `wallet_address` | Get wallet public address |
| `wallet_balance` | `wallet_balance` | Get wallet balances |
| `wallet_approve` | `wallet_approve` | Approve wallet for payments |
| `pointer_keys` | `pointer_keys` | Pointer addresses this daemon holds owner keys for. Free |
| `pointer_get(address, include_owner_key?)` | `pointer_get` | Read a pointer; the owner's public key only with `include_owner_key=True`. Free |
| `pointer_resolve(address)` | `pointer_resolve` | Follow forwardings and transfers to the target. Free |
| `pointer_finality(address)` | `pointer_finality` | The close group's view: open / settling / unconfirmed / final / forked. Free |
| `pointer_controller(address)` | `pointer_controller` | Follow transfers to the pointer whose owner now decides. Free |
| `pointer_create(owner, target, kind?)` | `pointer_create` | Create a pointer. Pays from the daemon wallet |
| `pointer_update(owner, target, kind?)` | `pointer_update` | Point a pointer at a new target. Pays from the daemon wallet |
| `pointer_transfer(owner, recipient, confirm_irreversible?)` | `pointer_transfer` | Hand a pointer over for good. Pays; irreversible, so it refuses to run (`CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, nothing sent or paid) without `confirm_irreversible=true` |
| `pointer_prepare(owner, op, target?, kind?, recipient?)` | `pointer_prepare` | External signer: sign and quote a pointer write. Pays nothing itself |
| `pointer_finalize(upload_id, tx_hashes)` | `pointer_finalize` | External signer: store a prepared write after `payForQuotes()` |

No pointer tool retries a paid write; counters come back as decimal strings.

| `build_manifest(entries, name?, torrent_info_hashes?, embed_roots?)` | `build_manifest` | Build a manifest from DataMaps and public addresses; returns `manifest_base64`, `link` (null past 1,500 bytes) and entries. Free |
| `decode_manifest(manifest_base64? \| link?, resolve?)` | `decode_manifest` | Decode a manifest, manifest link, file link or address; `resolve=true` fills `exact_size`. Free |

---

## Error Codes

| HTTP | gRPC Status | JS/TS Error | Python Exception | C# Exception | Kotlin Exception | Swift Error | Java Exception | Rust Variant | C++ Error | Meaning |
|------|-------------|-------------|------------------|--------------|------------------|-------------|----------------|--------------|-----------|---------|
| 400 | INVALID_ARGUMENT | `BadRequestError` | `BadRequestError` | `BadRequestException` | `BadRequestException` | `BadRequestError` | `BadRequestException` | `AntdError::BadRequest` | `BadRequestError` | Malformed request |
| 402 | FAILED_PRECONDITION | `PaymentError` | `PaymentError` | `PaymentException` | `PaymentException` | `PaymentError` | `PaymentException` | `AntdError::Payment` | `PaymentError` | Insufficient wallet funds |
| 404 | NOT_FOUND | `NotFoundError` | `NotFoundError` | `NotFoundException` | `NotFoundException` | `NotFoundError` | `NotFoundException` | `AntdError::NotFound` | `NotFoundError` | Address not found on network |
| 409 | ALREADY_EXISTS | `AlreadyExistsError` | `AlreadyExistsError` | `AlreadyExistsException` | `AlreadyExistsException` | `AlreadyExistsError` | `AlreadyExistsException` | `AntdError::AlreadyExists` | `AlreadyExistsError` | Resource already exists |
| 409 | ABORTED | `ForkError` | `ForkError` | `ForkException` | `ForkException` | `ForkError` | `ForkException` | `AntdError::Fork` | `ForkError` | Version conflict / fork |
| 413 | RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED | `TooLargeError` | `TooLargeError` | `TooLargeException` | `TooLargeException` | `TooLargeError` | `TooLargeException` | `AntdError::TooLarge` | `TooLargeError` | Data exceeds size limit |
| 500 | INTERNAL | `InternalError` | `InternalError` | `InternalException` | `InternalException` | `InternalError` | `InternalException` | `AntdError::Internal` | `InternalError` | Internal server error |
| 502 | UNAVAILABLE | `NetworkError` | `NetworkError` | `NetworkException` | `NetworkException` | `NetworkError` | `NetworkException` | `AntdError::Network` | `NetworkError` | Cannot reach network |
| 503 | UNAVAILABLE | `ServiceUnavailableError` | `ServiceUnavailableError` | `ServiceUnavailableException` | `ServiceUnavailableException` | `ServiceUnavailableError` | `ServiceUnavailableException` | `AntdError::ServiceUnavailable` | `ServiceUnavailableError` | Wallet not configured |
| 409 `POINTER_FINAL` | FAILED_PRECONDITION + tag | `PointerFinalError` | `PointerFinalError` | `PointerFinalException` | `PointerFinalException` | `PointerFinalError` | `PointerFinalException` | `AntdError::PointerFinal` | `PointerFinalError` | Pointer transferred or final; refused before paying |
| 409 `POINTER_FORKED` | FAILED_PRECONDITION + tag | `ForkError` | `PointerForkedError` | `PointerForkedException` | `PointerForkedException` | `PointerForkedError` | `ForkException` | `AntdError::PointerForked` | `PointerForkedError` | Owner signed two final states, no majority holds either |
| 409 `CONFLICT` | ABORTED + tag | `ConflictError` | `ConflictError` | `ConflictException` | `ConflictException` | `ConflictError` | `ConflictException` | `AntdError::Conflict` | `ConflictError` | A prepared pointer write awaits payment, or an update lost to a newer state |
| 503 `CLOSE_GROUP_SHORTFALL` | UNAVAILABLE + tag | `CloseGroupShortfallError` | `CloseGroupShortfallError` | `CloseGroupShortfallException` | `CloseGroupShortfallException` | `CloseGroupShortfallError` | `CloseGroupShortfallException` | `AntdError::CloseGroupShortfall` | `CloseGroupShortfallError` | Too few of the close group answered or stored; `retryable` only for a finalize that kept the paid state |

The four pointer-era rows share a status with older errors: SDKs map them by the REST body's `code`, and over gRPC by the `x-antd-error-code` trailer ("tag"), trusted only when it agrees with the status code. A daemon with pointers also sends `CLOSE_GROUP_SHORTFALL` from non-pointer calls (a chunk store, say) where older daemons sent a 500.

All exceptions inherit from `AntdError` (JS/TS, Python, Swift, Ruby, Lua, Zig, C++) / `AntdException` (C#, Kotlin, Java, PHP, Dart, Elixir uses `{:error, reason}` tuples). Rust uses `Result<T, AntdError>` with `match` on enum variants.

---

## Runnable Examples

### Store and Retrieve Public Data (Python)

```python
from antd import AntdClient

client = AntdClient()
result = client.data_put_public(b"Hello, Autonomi!")
print(f"Stored at: {result.address}, cost: {result.cost}")

data = client.data_get_public(result.address)
print(f"Retrieved: {data.decode()}")
```

### Store and Retrieve Public Data (Kotlin)

```kotlin
import com.autonomi.sdk.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking

fun main() = runBlocking {
    val client = AntdClient.createRest()
    val result = client.dataPutPublic("Hello, Autonomi!".toByteArray())
    println("Stored at: ${result.address}, cost: ${result.cost}")

    val data = client.dataGetPublic(result.address)
    println("Retrieved: ${String(data)}")
    client.close()
}
```

### Store and Retrieve Public Data (Swift)

```swift
import AntdSdk

let client = try AntdClient.createRest()
let result = try await client.dataPutPublic("Hello, Autonomi!".data(using: .utf8)!)
print("Stored at: \(result.address), cost: \(result.cost)")

let data = try await client.dataGetPublic(address: result.address)
print("Retrieved: \(String(data: data, encoding: .utf8)!)")
```

### Store and Retrieve Public Data (Go)

```go
package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "log"

    antd "github.com/WithAutonomi/ant-sdk/antd-go"
)

func main() {
    client := antd.NewClient(antd.DefaultBaseURL)
    ctx := context.Background()

    result, err := client.DataPutPublic(ctx, []byte("Hello, Autonomi!"))
    if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
    fmt.Printf("Stored at: %s, cost: %s\n", result.Address, result.Cost)

    data, err := client.DataGetPublic(ctx, result.Address)
    if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
    fmt.Printf("Retrieved: %s\n", string(data))
}
```

### Store and Retrieve Public Data (Java)

```java
import com.autonomi.antd.AntdClient;
import com.autonomi.antd.PutResult;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        try (AntdClient client = AntdClient.create()) {
            PutResult result = client.dataPutPublic("Hello, Autonomi!".getBytes());
            System.out.printf("Stored at: %s, cost: %s%n", result.address(), result.cost());

            byte[] data = client.dataGetPublic(result.address());
            System.out.printf("Retrieved: %s%n", new String(data));
        }
    }
}
```

### Store and Retrieve Public Data (Rust)

```rust
use antd_client::Client;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), antd_client::AntdError> {
    let client = Client::new("http://localhost:8082");

    let result = client.data_put_public(b"Hello, Autonomi!").await?;
    println!("Stored at: {}, cost: {}", result.address, result.cost);

    let data = client.data_get_public(&result.address).await?;
    println!("Retrieved: {}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&data));
    Ok(())
}
```

### Store and Retrieve Public Data (C++)

```cpp
#include <antd/antd.hpp>
#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    try {
        antd::Client client;
        std::string payload = "Hello, Autonomi!";
        std::vector<uint8_t> data(payload.begin(), payload.end());

        auto result = client.dataPutPublic(data);
        std::cout << "Stored at: " << result.address << ", cost: " << result.cost << std::endl;

        auto retrieved = client.dataGetPublic(result.address);
        std::cout << "Retrieved: " << std::string(retrieved.begin(), retrieved.end()) << std::endl;
    } catch (const antd::AntdError& e) {
        std::cerr << "Error: " << e.what() << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
```

### Store and Retrieve Public Data (Ruby)

```ruby
require "antd"

client = Antd::Client.new
result = client.data_put_public("Hello, Autonomi!")
puts "Stored at: #{result.address}, cost: #{result.cost}"

data = client.data_get_public(result.address)
puts "Retrieved: #{data}"
```

### Store and Retrieve Public Data (PHP)

```php
<?php
use Autonomi\AntdClient;

$client = AntdClient::create();
$result = $client->dataPutPublic("Hello, Autonomi!");
echo "Stored at: {$result->address}, cost: {$result->cost}\n";

$data = $client->dataGetPublic($result->address);
echo "Retrieved: {$data}\n";
```

### Store and Retrieve Public Data (Dart)

```dart
import 'package:antd/antd.dart';

void main() async {
  final client = AntdClient();
  final result = await client.dataPutPublic('Hello, Autonomi!'.codeUnits);
  print('Stored at: ${result.address}, cost: ${result.cost}');

  final data = await client.dataGetPublic(result.address);
  print('Retrieved: ${String.fromCharCodes(data)}');
}
```

### Store and Retrieve Public Data (Lua)

```lua
local antd = require("antd")

local client = antd.Client.new()
local result = client:data_put_public("Hello, Autonomi!")
print("Stored at: " .. result.address .. ", cost: " .. result.cost)

local data = client:data_get_public(result.address)
print("Retrieved: " .. data)
```

### Store and Retrieve Public Data (Elixir)

```elixir
client = Antd.Client.new()

{:ok, result} = Antd.Client.data_put_public(client, "Hello, Autonomi!")
IO.puts("Stored at: #{result.address}, cost: #{result.cost}")

{:ok, data} = Antd.Client.data_get_public(client, result.address)
IO.puts("Retrieved: #{data}")
```

### Store and Retrieve Public Data (Zig)

```zig
const std = @import("std");
const antd = @import("antd");

pub fn main() !void {
    var client = try antd.Client.init(.{});
    defer client.deinit();

    const result = try client.dataPutPublic("Hello, Autonomi!");
    std.debug.print("Stored at: {s}, cost: {s}\n", .{ result.address, result.cost });

    const data = try client.dataGetPublic(result.address);
    std.debug.print("Retrieved: {s}\n", .{data});
}
```

### Private Data Round-Trip (Python)

```python
from antd import AntdClient

client = AntdClient()

# Store private (encrypted) data
result = client.data_put_private(b"secret message")
print(f"Data map: {result.address}")

# Retrieve with data map
data = client.data_get_private(result.address)
print(f"Decrypted: {data.decode()}")
```

### Pointer: Create, Update, Resolve (Python)

```python
from antd import AlreadyExistsError, AntdClient

client = AntdClient()
owner = client.pointer_keys()[0]   # antd started with --pointer-keys

v1 = client.data_put_public(b"version 1").address
v2 = client.data_put_public(b"version 2").address

try:
    client.pointer_create(owner, v1)          # pays; counter 0
except AlreadyExistsError:
    pass                                      # refused before paying: it exists, so update it
w = client.pointer_update(owner, v2)          # pays; never retried automatically
print(f"Pointer {w.address} at counter {w.counter}")

target = client.pointer_resolve(owner).target  # == v2 (free)
print(client.data_get_public(target).decode()) # "version 2"
print(client.pointer_finality(owner).status.value)  # "open"
```

Runnable in every SDK: `ANTD_POINTER_OWNER=<address> ant dev example pointers -l <language>` (`ANTD_BASE_URL` overrides the daemon URL in all but Go and Rust).
